description: Land Title Settlement Department  -   Sippilulama, Hambanthota D/S Division, Hambanthota District  - Cad. Map No. 830111 and other declarations
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extent measurements, ownership details (both private and state-owned), and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category.
